task: Predict CTNNB1 mutation status in endometrial carcinoma. Classes: negative vs. positive. On H&E, CTNNB1-mutant tumors often show low-grade endometrioid morphology with squamous differentiation, while negative tumors lack this mutation-associated pattern.

classes.0: CTNNB1-negative endometrial carcinoma lacking the characteristic low-grade endometrioid and squamous differentiation pattern linked to mutation.
classes.1: CTNNB1-positive endometrial carcinoma with low-grade endometrioid morphology and frequent squamous differentiation.
